name: the separator row stops being required, so a sentence containing two pipes is a table
edits:
if i + 1 >= len(lines) or not _SEPARATOR.match(lines[i + 1]):
            continue
expect: table: rows with no separator between them are not a table

name: a separator needs two dashes again, so valid GFM `|-|-|` is rejected
expect: table: single-dash separator is valid markdown

name: a table row no longer has to close with a pipe
edits: if not s.startswith("|") or not s.endswith("|") or len(s) < 3:
expect: table: trailing text after the closing pipe is not a row

name: code fences stop being skipped, so an EXAMPLE table counts as a report
expect: table: inside a code fence is an EXAMPLE, not a report

name: a header and separator with zero claim rows is accepted again
expect: table: header + separator but NO claim rows reports nothing

name: the trigger matches anywhere again, so `git pushover` reads as a push
expect: acts: substring is not a match

name: git global options are no longer skipped, so `git -C dir commit` is missed
expect: acts: a git global option before commit too

name: a rehearsal counts as an act, so --dry-run closes a job
expect: acts: --dry-run rehearses and performs nothing

name: the command is no longer split into segments, so a chain hides the real act
expect: acts: && chain still counts the real act

name: an env assignment prefix is no longer stripped, so the invocation is missed
expect: acts: an env prefix is part of the invocation

name: the interpreter prefix is dropped, so the real begin-plan invocation is missed
expect: acts: plan tick

name: a refused push counts as work, so a blocked act closes a job
expect: acts: errored tool_use ignored

name: a present table no longer silences the warning, so every close warns
expect: decide: acts + table -> quiet

name: a close with NO report at all goes quiet again — the r1 High, restored
edits:
return WARN, (
            f"CLOSING TABLE MISSING — the previous turn completed {', '.join(acts)} and reported "

return QUIET, (
            f"CLOSING TABLE MISSING — the previous turn completed {', '.join(acts)} and reported "
expect: decide: acts + NO text at all -> warn (a close with no report at all)

name: the log path is rendered with relative_to again, so a redirected log raises
expect: log display: outside the repo does not raise

name: the closing message becomes the FIRST text block instead of the last
expect: final: last non-empty wins

name: an unreadable transcript passes quietly — the fail-open direction
edits:
"warning as 'no table was owed'.", file=sys.stderr)
        return CANNOT_RUN

"warning as 'no table was owed'.", file=sys.stderr)
        return QUIET
expect: run: empty payload -> CANNOT RUN

name: the LIVE turn is judged, so the unflushed final message reads as absent
expect: run: only one turn -> QUIET (no subject yet)

name: quotes stop being masked, so a quoted operator splits the command
expect: acts: a quoted operator does not split the command

name: fences toggle again, so one unterminated marker silences every table after it
edits:
for a, b in zip(markers[::2], markers[1::2]):
        fenced_lines.update(range(a, b + 1))

for a in markers:
        fenced_lines.update(range(a, len(lines)))
expect: table: an unclosed fence before the table hides nothing

name: brackets are stripped after env prefixes again, so a subshell hides a real close
expect: acts: a subshell with an env prefix is still a push
